name: “Who are you trying to impress with these travel stories?”
source: /Users/aaron/Downloads/100 Viral Formats (Format Book)/Easy to use format/#8/#8.mp4

lines.ref:
“Who are you trying
to impress with these
travel stories?”

shots.brief: impressive travel or high-achievement outdoor view, selfie (ref: Creator films a selfie while hiking at sunset, turning around to point at a smoking volcanic peak above the clouds.; selfie)
old childhood photo of younger self (ref: Still childhood photo of the creator as a little girl sitting on the stairs in pajamas, smiling at the camera.; other)

audit.notes: Requires an archival childhood photo of the creator to deliver the emotional punchline ('her' / 'him'). A standard library of adult lifestyle b-roll is not sufficient without digging up an old family picture.
audit.summary: A travel creator turns the camera to reveal an epic view of an erupting volcano with text asking who she's trying to impress, then cuts to a nostalgic childhood photo with the caption 'her.'
